title: Motion Blur in Old Master Art
content: Did any artists from before the era of photography capture the effect of motion blur?Diego Velázquez,Detail ofLas Hilanderas(The Spinners),1655-1660A good place to look are images of spinning wheels. The spokes dissolve into a blur when it really gets spinning.Esaias Boursse,Interior with an Woman at a Spinning Wheel,1667Painting the spokes that way is a remarkable choice, because it means allowing the impression to  overrule the knowledge of the actual structure. Once the era of photography arrived, artists were fascinated by motion blur, but only a few have used it in their paintings.It has shown up as a joke in this Charles Dana Gibson cartoon, and it also appears in the wildlife art ofManfred Schatz.----Previous posts that mention motion blurManfred Schatz: Wildlife in Action
